description: One source of a document comparison as a card (redesign 146c7e1b, phase 7, DE-2.6): the role of the source as the title ('Original document', 'New document'), an icon, what the source is (a label and an optional second line) and a 'Change...' button that opens the picker, which the host renders as ChildContent under the card body while Expanded. The card owns no state - the compare dialog decides what is chosen and whether the picker is open. Test ids: document-compare-{Side}-card, -label, -change, -editor.

parameters.name: Side
parameters.description: Which side of the comparison the card stands for: base or target. It names the card's test ids and data-side.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The role of the source, shown as the card title ("Original document", "New document").

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: What the source is: the current document, a file name, a version label or a document id.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: An optional second line under the label (the kind of source, the author and time of a version).

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: Icon name of the source kind.

parameters.name: Expanded
parameters.description: Whether the picker below the card is open. The card never changes it: the host handles OnChange.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the 'Change...' button, for example while a comparison runs.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: The picker, rendered under the card body while Expanded.
